stories.title: Define sponsor credibility schema and data contract
stories.description: Create Pydantic models and internal schema for sponsor credibility including fields: sponsor_type, funding_source, institution_name, collaborators, reputation_score, transparency_flag, and raw ClinicalTrials.gov fields mapping (lead_sponsor, collaborators, funding_source).
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models/clinical_trials_models.py (existing Pydantic pattern); ClinicalTrials.gov fields (lead_sponsor, collaborator, funding_source) referenced in feature definition.

stories.title: Implement sponsor credibility scoring logic
stories.description: Build backend logic to classify sponsor type (university, hospital, pharma, unknown), normalize funding source (NIH/NCI/public vs industry vs undisclosed), and compute credibility score based on rules (public + reputable institution = positive, unknown + undisclosed = negative). Include collaborator influence and fallback handling for missing data.

stories.title: Expose sponsor credibility via evaluation API
stories.description: Extend clinical trials evaluation response to include sponsor credibility object with score, classification, and explanation text. Integrate into EvaluateCare facade for downstream UI consumption.

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for sponsor credibility measure
stories.description: Create tests validating schema parsing, sponsor classification, funding normalization, scoring rules, and API response integration. Include edge cases: missing sponsor, multiple collaborators, undisclosed funding.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing pytest framework and patterns for service and tool validation).
